plugin.description: Sends your notes and button commands to URLs you choose, as POST requests with the headers you set. Use it to feed notes, todos, ideas and triggers from your Pebble into your own server, automation or note system.

actions.name: send_message
actions.description: Send the user's text to their own configured webhook URL as an HTTP POST. Use only when the user explicitly asks to send, save, capture or log something to their webhook.

text.description: The complete message to send, preferably the user's exact words.

actions.name: send_command
actions.description: Send one of the user's preconfigured button commands to its configured webhook URL as an HTTP POST. Use only when the user explicitly asks to trigger that button command.

slot.description: Which configured button command to send.

actions.name: get_labels
actions.description: Internal use by the VoiceHook watchapp: returns the button labels as JSON. Not for general use.
